body:
Eva Li: Hey team — handing off zephyr-v2-lite (FP16, ~13B) from model intake. Passed perf smoke and eval harness. Need prioritization for quant experiments and chat template + toolcall schema. TL;DR: latency looks fine on dedicated nodes; possible regressions on NLU slot tests.

Maria Gomez: High-level notes? which NLU tests failed?

intake-bot: CI model-intake/zephyr-v2-lite: evals completed 1912345600. metrics: ppl=8.2, squad-f1=86.1, slot-extraction F1 drop = -3.1 pts. artifacts: s3://redwood-models/zephyr-v2-lite/. logs: s3://redwood-logs/zephyr-v2-lite/run-1912345600.log

Sam Patel: I can own quant experiments next week. Prioritize: 1) q4_* family (q4_0, q4_k_m) vs 4-bit int8 sims, 2) act-order sanity checks, 3) calibration on NER/slot prompts.

Jonas Reed: Runtime constraints: prefer groupwise quant + KV caching enabled. Also ensure model artifact includes config `max_seq=2048` and kernel hints for attention.

Eva Li: Prompt formatting reqs — chat template snippet below. Need eng-ml to validate tool calling + structured output compliance.

Eva Li: ```
[system] You are Redwood Assistant. Answer concisely. If a tool is needed, call the tool with JSON: {"tool":..., "args":...}
[user] "<user_query>"
```

Maria Gomez: For tool calling we want a single JSON object on its own line in the assistant message. Example: 
```
{"tool":"search","args":{"query":"best italian restaurants near me"},"metadata":{"trace_id":"<uuid>"}}
```
SDK should parse that into a ToolCall object. If the assistant returns free text and a tool call, prefer tool call first.

Sam Patel: Quick checklist for bring-up (my suggested ordering):
- smoke perf on dedicated infra
- baseline PPL/QA/SMOKE evals vs golden prompts
- quant A/B (q4_* + int8) on key prompts (latency + quality)
- structured-output parser tests (JSON schema + edge cases)
- canary serving config (route -> fallback)

Jonas Reed: Add: include kernel preference file and a runtime fallback to float16 when quant path fails. Also validate KV cache hot paths.

Maria Gomez: Also create a small prompt bank for NER/slot/QA with golden outputs. I'll seed ~40 prompts across domains and edge cases. Will post link.

Eva Li: Can someone add a short PR to docs/ and a Console route config? I can draft the prompt bank. Sam — can you own quant experiments and post results in this thread? :thumbsup:

Sam Patel: Yep. I'll create a branch `zephyr-v2-lite/quant-primes` and post a short summary + table of runs. First runs: q4_0, q4_k_m, int8-symmetric.

deploy-bot: CI build passed for branch zephyr-v2-lite/quant-primes (jobs: unit, lint) — 1912345850

Sam Patel: First smoke run scheduled tomorrow 08:00 PST. I'll post results here (latency, mem, key-prompt delta).

Maria Gomez: tagging eng-ml-oncall @Jonas Reed for kernel validation and early QA checks.

Jonas Reed: I'll review kernel selection and schedule a 15-min sync if we see any weird regressions. Thanks everyone.
